1.body:
Hello,

I saw your opening for a UI/UX Designer at Adept Global and was drawn to your focus on combining visual design systems with AI-powered creative workflows.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I build reusable visual design systems and digital assets that cut down turnaround time. Previously at AT Creation, I handled wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing to improve interface usability.

My B2B UX case study, Bounceless, demonstrates my process for creating a cleaner verification experience and structured wireframing. You can review it in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Mumbai for this role. Would you be open to a quick look at my case study?

Ananya
